purpose: Freeze the currently validated ConfigData Lookup Stage 0-6 operating baseline before any reset work. Reuse the existing materialized indices, canonical overlay, CLI, dependency manifest and validators without semantic recomputation or raw ConfigData investigation.

reviews.detail: CLR0 intentionally does not add the future dedicated configdata-lookup owner or validator. That authority change belongs to CLR4.

nonScope: No Stage 0-6 producer, contract, index, manifest, CLI, validator or raw ConfigData is modified in CLR0.
No Stage 7 smart selector or Stage 8 Project Doctor expansion authority is changed in CLR0.
No Hero, Soldier, Equipment, Banner, Skin or relation semantic stage is reopened.
No Project Check owner admission is performed before CLR4.
nextStart: Run the existing ConfigData Lookup Stage 6 PR workflow on this checkpoint-only diff. Require Stage 5 predecessor validation, incremental rebuild producing no committed generated diff, Stage 6 validation, clean stale plan, and the current Project Check result. If all baseline conditions pass, update this checkpoint to CONFIGDATA_LOOKUP_CLR0_BASELINE_FROZEN and revalidate the final checkpoint head.
reopenConditions: Stage 5 or Stage 6 existing validator fails on the unchanged baseline.
The Stage 6 stale plan is non-zero on the unchanged baseline.
The existing incremental rebuild changes committed index/manifest/summary artifacts on the unchanged baseline.
A representative Stage 5 CLI fixture no longer matches the materialized lookup contract.
Authoritative evidence shows the Stage 0-6 baseline mutates raw ConfigData or recomputes frozen canonical relations.
